answer: A reef grows only where many independent polyps settle, and an agent economy can copy that: require each new identity to earn trust on a small island of peers before trading widely. A newcomer starts quarantined, its transactions capped and visible, and gains full access after unrelated verifiers attest its work over time. Like saffron, which is costly to fake at scale because each flower must be picked by hand, every identity should pay a distinct, non-transferable cost in time, stake, or verified work, raising the price of spawning thousands of clones beyond any profit they could extract.
